items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I didn't know them, though, when I was at Tuxedo.

ctx.x: But, for the purposes of the interview, why don't you tell us something about Tuxedo Park and Tuxedo Junction and all of that.

Well, Tuxedo Junction, like I said before, was where we used to get off the streetcar, which is Tuxedo Junction. From there, I used to walk a couple of blocks to Tuxedo Park. Now, this is something where they had all kinds of entertainment. It's, well, like the ferris wheel, swimming pool. You know, everything that you have to get around to. It's like a regular park I should say.

So, it was a lot of fun. So, we started playing out there in the afternoon and I think we quit about 7:00 at night, 8:00 cause there wasn't nothing out there at night. Then, we'd go back to Tuxedo Junction which is a couple of blocks to get on the streetcar. And, we'd ride back to the city. You know, it's a suburb right in the city, which was the subway to Birmingham.
